title: QUIC RFC 9000 CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P19 requirement-home tests, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, Release build, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused CONNECTION_CLOSE frame parsing, formatting, reason phrase, packet-space, and handshake-abandon behavior for the listed S19P19 requirements.
expected_result: S19P19 requirement-home tests prove transport versus application close frame type handling, required fields, variable-length field preservation, malformed and truncated payload rejection, reason phrase bounds, zero-length and malformed reason payload handling, application-close packet-space classification, and handshake-abandon transport-close emission.
procedure: Run the focused S19P19 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: Existing CONNECTION_CLOSE parser and formatter behavior remains in QuicFrameCodec.
Existing packet-number-space classification remains in QuicPacketParser.
Existing local close behavior remains in QuicConnectionRuntime.Lifecycle.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim S19P20 HANDSHAKE_DONE closure, S20/S21 registry and security closure, close retransmission policy, or packet-level close emission behavior beyond the focused S19P19 runtime assertions.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S19P19 tail filter passed 59/59, the full no-build solution test pass completed 4059/4059, and generated triage resolves the nineteen targeted requirements as trace-clean.
